title: TCG:PRO-020

power.text: You can play this card instead of a major hero this round. Exhaust a friendly major hero Seeker to put Tao from your legendary hero pile into zone 1. The exhausted Seeker doesn't ready at the start at the next round.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
This card was a prize given out at the Huntik National Championships in 2009. From what is known, only 120 were ever made. They were given out as follows:

*'''Great Britain National Championship''' - Top 32 competitors
*'''Italy National Championship''' - Top 32 competitors
*'''Germany National Championship''' - Top 32 competitors
*'''Benelux National Championship''' - Top 8 competitors
*'''New Zealand National Championship''' - Top 8 competitors
*'''Austalia National Championship''' - Top 8 competitors
